tool.name: RiboHub: Generate Gwips Track Hub
tool.description: Build a Gwips RiboSeq track hub from bigWig and bigBed files
tool.command:
## Generate random 15-char folder ID for unique hub URL #import string #import random #set $chars = string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits #set $rand_id = ''.join(random.choice($chars) for _ in range(15))
chmod 777 /export/galaxy/hub_output 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p '/export/galaxy/hub_output/genomebrowsertrack/$rand_id' &&
/tool_deps/_conda/bin/ribohub generate --output-dir '/export/galaxy/hub_output/genomebrowsertrack/$rand_id' --output-format 'single-file' --genome '$genome' --metadata '/data/metadata.csv'
## Sample input #if $sample_source.source_type == "file" --samples '$sample_source.sample_file' #else if $sample_source.source_type == "text" --samples '$sample_source.sample_text' #end if
## Read types #set $kind_list = [] #if $kinds.kind_all #silent $kind_list.append("all") #end if #if $kinds.kind_unique #silent $kind_list.append("unique") #end if #if $kinds.kind_multi #silent $kind_list.append("multi") #end if #if $kind_list --kinds '${",".join($kind_list)}' #end if
## Track options #if $with_aggregates --with-aggregates #else --no-aggregates #end if
#if $with_regions --with-regions #else --no-regions #end if
## Metadata filter #if $metadata_filter --filter '$metadata_filter' #end if
$dry_run
## Output: URL pointing to the served hub #if not $dry_run && echo "http://\$SERVER_IP/genomebrowsertrack/${rand_id}/RiboSeqHub.hub.txt" > '$hub_output' #end if

param.name: sample_file
param.label: Sample list
param.help: CSV (first column = SRR IDs) or plain text (one SRR per line).

param.name: metadata_filter
param.label: Filter samples from metadata (optional)
param.help: Format: COL=VAL or COL=VAL1/VAL2 (OR), comma-separated (AND). Example: CELL_LINE=HEK293,CONDITION=High

param.name: with_aggregates
param.label: Include strand overlays
param.help: Per-sample transparent overlay of forward + reverse strands.

param.name: with_regions
param.label: Include region annotations
param.help: Include bigBed region tracks (e.g. ORFs) if available.

param.name: dry_run
param.label: Dry run
param.help: Preview what would be built without writing any files.

tool.help:
**RiboHub: Generate Gwips Track Hub**
Builds a Gwips track hub from sorted bigWig files produced by the RiboSeqOrg pipeline.
-----
**How to provide samples**
Three options:
1. *Upload a file*: CSV (first column = SRR IDs) or plain text (one per line) 2. *Type SRR IDs*: enter them directly, comma-separated 3. *Metadata filter only*: select samples by properties (cell line, condition, etc.)
You can combine a sample list with a metadata filter to narrow the selection.
-----
**What you get**
After the tool runs, your Galaxy history will contain a **Hub URL**. Copy this URL and paste it into GWIPS-viz (My Data → Track Hubs → My Hubs).
Each run generates a uniquely named hub so previous hubs are never overwritten.
-----
**Metadata filter examples**
- ``CELL_LINE=HEK293``= all HEK293 samples - ``CONDITION=High/Test``= High OR Test condition - ``CELL_LINE=HEK293,CONDITION=High``= HEK293 AND High condition
